name: AOG Email Agent, Daily Executive Summary

parameters.content:
## Daily executive summary

Five sections, every day, whether or not they have anything in them:

- New Opportunities
- Critical Deadlines
- High-Priority Comms
- Outstanding Follow-ups
- Awaiting Decision

An empty section prints "None." (SUMX-03). It is never omitted and never padded with yesterday.

Scoped to a 24 hour window. No carryover.
